content: Cephalexin, USP, is a semisynthetic cephalosporin antibiotic designed for oral administration. Its chemical name is 7-(D-α-amino-α-phenylacetamido)-3-methyl-3-cephem-4-carboxylic acid, monohydrate. The structural formula of cephalexin reveals that its molecular nucleus is related to other cephalosporin antibiotics. The molecule contains both a basic and an acidic group. Cephalexin is available in a crystalline monohydrate form. It appears as a white crystalline solid with a bitter taste. Its solubility in water is low at room temperature, with 1 to 2 mg/mL dissolving readily, but achieving higher concentrations becomes increasingly difficult. Cephalosporins differ from penicillins in the structure of their bicyclic ring system. Cephalexin specifically has a D-phenylglycyl group as a substituent at the 7-amino position and an unsubstituted methyl group at the 3-position. Each capsule of cephalexin contains cephalexin monohydrate equivalent to either 250 mg (720 μmol) or 500 mg (1,439 μmol) of cephalexin. The inactive ingredients in the capsules include magnesium stearate, silicon dioxide, and sodium starch glycolate. The capsule shell and print constituents include black iron oxide, D&C Yellow 10 Aluminum Lake, FD&C Blue 1 Aluminum Lake, FD&C Blue 2 Aluminum Lake, FD&C Red 40 Aluminum Lake, gelatin, pharmaceutical glaze modified in SD-45, silicon dioxide or carboxymethylcellulose sodium, sodium lauryl sulfate, titanium dioxide, and may contain propylene glycol. Additionally, the 250 mg capsule shell contains yellow iron oxide. When mixed, each 5 mL of cephalexin oral suspension USP contains cephalexin monohydrate equivalent to either 125 mg (360 μmol) or 250 mg (720 μmol) of cephalexin. The inactive ingredients in the suspension include FD&C Red 40, cherry mixed fruit flavor (artificial flavors, benzyl alcohol, maltodextrin, and modified corn starch), silicon dioxide, sodium benzoate, sugar (fruit granulated), and xanthan gum. Each tablet of cephalexin contains cephalexin monohydrate equivalent to either 250 mg (720 μmol) or 500 mg (1,439 μmol) of cephalexin. The inactive ingredients in the tablets include hypromellose, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, polysorbate 80, sodium starch glycolate, and titanium dioxide.
